```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(listings_count = dplyr::n())

host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(listings_count >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(hosts_10_plus = dplyr::n())

# Continued
listings_with_count = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")
  
listings_with_count |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    chicago_listings_over10 = sum(listings_count >= 10),
    chicago_total = dplyr::n(),
    chicago_share = round(chicago_listings_over10 / chicago_total * 100, 1)
  )
```

## Task 2
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    listings = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  
  dplyr::filter(listings >= 20) |>
  
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)
```


## Task 3
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      median,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```


## Task 4
```{r}
revenue_ranked = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  )

revenue_ranked |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_10_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10_share = round(top_10_revenue / total_revenue * 100, 1)
  )
```

## Task 5
```{r}
october = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

entire_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

october |>
  dplyr::inner_join(entire_homes, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    mostly_taken_share = mean(mostly_taken) * 100
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mostly_taken_share)
```


## Task 6
```{r}
reviews_city_month = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(listings, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(city, dplyr::desc(total_reviews))
reviews_city_month
```

## Task 6 Continued
```{r}
reviews_city_month |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    busiest = max(total_reviews),
    quietest = min(total_reviews),
    ratio = round(busiest / quietest, 2)
  )
```


## Task 7
```{r}
superhost_prices = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

superhost_prices |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    superhost_premium = median_price[host_is_superhost == "t"] -
      median_price[host_is_superhost == "f"]
  )
```


## Task 8
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::summarize(listings_without_availability = dplyr::n())
```


## B2
```{r}
listings_with_count |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    listings_over10 = sum(listings_count >= 10),
    total_listings = dplyr::n(),
    share = round(listings_over10 / total_listings * 100, 1)
  )
```
